_comment: SHA-256 of the PlatformIO platform zip that platformio.ini names and of the platform packages a release build installs. scripts/pin_firmware_toolchain.py checks every download against these before the release workflow builds; move them together with the platform URL. core_packages_not_in_builds: what PlatformIO Core installs for itself by URL (the PIO Home front end), which no build reads; the post-build check allows exactly these URLs. core_registry_packages: what PlatformIO Core installs for itself from the PlatformIO registry for every build (its own SCons, which takes the packages directory's tool-scons slot, so the platform's pinned tool-scons above is fetched and checked but not the copy that runs); the registry checksums them, this lock does not pin them, and the post-build check allows exactly these names from the registry.

core_registry_packages.tool-scons: PlatformIO Core's own SCons (platformio/tool-scons, from the PlatformIO registry)
